# Golden cases for think() (plan 2026-10-31 3.9-3.11): the same table is checked on PC (test_ai),
# in WASM (Node.js tests) and on the ESP32 (serial command `golden`), so that every build picks the
# same move. Generated by test/golden/gen_cases.cpp (build and run as its first lines say).
# Format (see lib/core/AiCase.h): board held head cooldowns gap lift params expect
#   board     n*n of . H M, row-major      held      - or r,c (origin of the held human piece)
#   head      r,c                          cooldowns - or r,c=ms[;...] (remaining)
#   gap       - or ms (placement interval left)   lift   - or ms since the held piece was lifted
#   params    freeSpeed,dragSpeed,engageMs,reactMs,level(E/N/H),aggression,readLift(0/1)
#   expect    none or r,c>r,c
# Every case has a gap of at least 0.1 between the best and the second-best contending score.
